content.text: LOs: Pain (NSAIDs, Opioids), Drugs of Abuse, Gout, Arthritis
diclofenac (topical gel/patch); also salicylic acid & methyl salicylate for external use
APAP: central analgesic/antipyretic, weak anti-inflam, ⍉antiplatelet, ⍉GI ulcer
NSAIDs: COX inhibition → anti-inflam + antiplatelet + GI/renal/CV AE
high COX-1 selectivity → irreversible platelet inhibition
dosing/appropriate use of acetaminophen in adult
watch hidden APAP in combo prod
Drug abuse: detrimental to health/wellbeing (user, others, society) -⍉just illegal drugs (Rx pain relievers > heroin + cocaine deaths combined)
Drug addiction: extreme abuse pattern (substance use dx)  -> preoccupied w procurement/use, neglect responsibilities & relationships
Drug dep: compelled to repeatedly use psychoactive drug
physical: cont use needed to prevent w.draw Sx/S                    -                psychological: (+) reinforcement → neuronal activation in nucleus accumbens
Reward: DA → D1-r in nucleus accumbens → ↑glutamate-r expression → sensitization (peak DA = peak drug effect)
cocaine/amphetamines → ↑DA release directly at n. terminals      -     opioids/nicotine/EToH/marijuana → via GABAergic interneurons (nucleus accumbens & VTA) → ↑DA indirectly
all → tol, dep, w.draw, CNS depress → resp depress, coma, death     -   stim → cardiac, sz, psychosis    -   Rx opioids = MC abused Rx class (more deaths than illicit drugs)
↓dose = selective CNS depress (↓inhibition)             -    ↑dose = general CNS depress → coma, resp depress, death
MC abused -life expectancy 10-15yr (chronic → hepatic/CV/pulm/heme/endocrine/met/CNS)         -    major cause of fatal MVAs, drowning, falls
w.draw: begins 6-8hr after cessation, lasts 3-5d → alt perception, insomnia, irritability, sz, tremor, HTN & tachy, N, sweating, delirium tremens (~5%)
w.draw tx: benzos (chlordiazepoxide, diazepam, lorazepam) = mainstay
naltrexone (↓craving/binge, no sig AE if EToH used)
sedative-hypnotics (anxiety, insomnia); abused for euphoria/anxiolytic, to blunt cocaine/amphetamine irritability; flunitrazepam = date-rape drug
Intox → emergency tx: flumazenil (parenteral benzo antagonist, IV) + supportive
heroin = MC abused illicit opioid (morphine + acetyl groups): potent, water-soluble, IV   -   rapid brain entry → intense euphoria
Rx opioids = MC abused Rx class
Intox: unresponsive, ↓resp, pinpoint pupils, cold/clammy skin, brady
agents: methylphenidate, dexmethylphenidate, dextroamphetamine, mixed amphetamine salts (Adderall), lisdexamfetamine (Vyvanse)
↑catecholamines (NE, 5-HT, DA) -> release intracell stores + ↓MAO + weakly ↓reuptake → ↑alert, ↓fatigue, ↓appetite, insomnia; euphoria ← ↑DA in nucleus accumbens
emergency tx: lorazepam (agitation), haloperidol (psychosis), monitor/support cardiac
block monoamine reuptake (NE, 5-HT, DA) → potentiate/prolong CNS & periph actions → intense euphoria
emergency tx: lorazepam (agitation/sz), support vitals; w.draw ~ amphetamines
mild direct CNS stimulant; also heart/CV
Clin Use: labeled — neonatal apnea            -     unlabeled — fatigue, drowsy, HA
anxiety, tremor, insomnia, dyspepsia, mild diuresis, ↑HR & BP               -    abrupt w.draw → HA, irritability, lethargy
Nicotine: 5 A's: Ask, Advise, Assess, Assist, Arrange
agonist at nicotinic-cholinergic-r (autonomic ganglia, adrenal medulla, NMJ, brain) — ↓dose ganglionic stim, ↑dose ganglionic blockade
↑ACh, β-endorphin, DA, NE, 5-HT → reinforcing; CV: peripheral vasoconstrict, tachy, ↑BP
w.draw: irritability, anxiety, restless, ↓concentration, HA, insomnia (start w.in 24hr, last 1-2wk)
Varenicline (Chantix): partial agonist at neuronal nicotinic ACh-r → ↓euphoria, ↓reward if smoke
suicidal thoughts, vivid nightmares, mood chg, N (30%)/V/constipation
serious neuropsych events (depression, SI/attempt/completed) — monitor during & after tx (BBW removed 2016, EAGLES)
dried flowers/leaves of Cannabis sativa; primary cannabinoid = THC (Δ9-tetrahydrocannabinol)
THC binds cannabinoid-r → modulate ACh, DA, 5-HT
stimulant phase: euphoria, altered time sense, ↑visual acuity, ↓concentration, ↓short-term memory → depressive phase: drowsy, lethargy, ↑appetite
Marinol (dronabinol, synthetic THC): chemo N/V (failed conventional tx) & AIDS-associated anorexia; forms — capsule, oral solution
hallucinations (usually visual) w.o delirium; OD rarely serious (panic attack poss)
euphoria, hallucinations, psychotomimetic ± hostility/violence; little tolerance, dependence, w.draw
